name: NPC idle settlement needs and equipment retry smoke

steps._note: Run on disposable solo and dedicated Purge with no natural humanoid NPCs. Capture equivalent idle native session counters before and after a host tick. Check that empty needs do not dirty the store, then repeat with a real existing need. Equipment mailbox delayed, repeated, out-of-order and expired control uses the controlled exact snapshot/native actor fixture on a dedicated peer, separately from this smoke.
